versions.subject: fixed various spelling errors all over rules and source code

selection_img:
  - Image|endswith: '\cmstp.exe'
  - OriginalFileName|contains: 'CMSTP.EXE'
selection_cli:

    - '/s'
    - '/au'
condition: all of selection*
